title: Introduction to Agentic PKM
excerpt: Most companies have brand messaging across too many places. AI tools cannot reliably access it. Structured markdown files with consistent formatting are already machine-readable — no vector database required.

title: Designing a Company PKM
excerpt: A practical guide to building your brand memory vault. Start simple — structured folders, consistent frontmatter, and clear naming give AI agents everything they need to retrieve and use your brand knowledge.

title: Why your operating model is the bottleneck — not your team
excerpt: Most scaling companies blame execution. They hire more people. Buy more tools. Run more standups. None of it works because the coordination model itself is broken.

title: Why we install in 12 weeks — and why nothing takes longer
excerpt: Fixed scope is not a constraint. It is the design. Parkinson's Law says work expands to fill the time available. We compress the time. The work compresses with it.

title: Campaigns are tactics. Engines are infrastructure.
excerpt: A campaign is a one-time event. A campaign engine is a system that produces campaigns on a cadence. One compounds. The other depletes. Most growth teams are stuck on the wrong side.

title: Removing the founder from the loop
excerpt: If growth decisions still route through the founder, the system is not installed yet. The model should run without them. Here is what that actually looks like.

title: Flow optimisation is not process improvement
excerpt: Process improvement assumes the current process is the right shape. Flow optimisation starts from first principles — how should work actually move through this system?
